## I2-03 technical target

A committed execution report arrives with `order_id`, execution fields and PositionEffect metadata, but futures state mutation also needs the original mapped `(account_id, product_id)` and order lifecycle context. I2-03 therefore needs an integration-owned outstanding-order metadata owner keyed by `order_id`.

The intended payload reuses the frozen RMIC AMU architecture but adds futures metadata rather than relying on frozen stock-like account accounting:

```text
order_id -> account_id + product_id + side + PositionEffect + limit/order context + remaining qty
```

Only a frozen-HFT sequence-owner committed R02/R32 event may look up this context and request a futures state mutation.
